# The RW engine's function-pointer slots as they stand once the game runs (retail PCSX2 memory at 0x00887200..0x00887600, via
# a PCSX2 RAM dump of 00887200..00887600 during a movie): `<slot address> <retail function address>`. ovdiff stores the native
# of each function in its slot (a logging callback where the port has none) so overrides that call through the engine table run.
# The memory slots 0x008873E8..0x008873F4 are the harness's own deterministic allocator instead.
